purpose: Teach: 列島/知覚/垂直/特異/不利益/中枢/著しい/ノード

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、警察、列島規模の捜査網を敷いております
lines.en: We have police resources deployed across the entire archipelago for this investigation.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Even pacing, no inflection on process words. Steady eye contact—briefing voice. Competent and contained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の知覚異常も慎重に評価されたんですね
lines.en: So the police evaluated the suspect's perceptual disturbances carefully too?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Careful articulation on technical terms. Seeking confirmation, not challenging. Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、垂直方向の建物落下事故を捜査中です
lines.en: We're investigating what appears to be a structural collapse—a building falling vertically.
lines.style: Clinical, deliberate pacing. Slight emphasis on 'vertically'—the detail that matters. No speculation in the voice. Just fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、特異な手口を警察、解明されたんですね
lines.en: So the police have uncovered something unusual about how this was done?
lines.style: Slow, careful formulation. Pausing between phrases like he's building understanding in real time. Respectful of complexity. No rush.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪被害者の不利益を補償する制度を支援しております
lines.en: We have a system in place to support crime victims—to help compensate them for losses and harm.
lines.style: Shift to softer authority. Slower tempo on the second clause. Personal stake underneath the procedural language. Measured conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織の中枢に警察、迫っておられるそうですね
lines.en: I hear the investigation is closing in on people at the center of this organization?
lines.style: Delicate phrasing—he's checking something sensitive. Quieter than before. Respectful hesitation. Seeking confirmation without pushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪率の著しい地区を集中警備しております
lines.en: We're putting concentrated security on districts where crime rates have risen significantly.
lines.style: Back to procedural register. Factual, brief. No emotion on the statistics. Professional distance returned. Still measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、通信ノードを警察、特定されたんですね
lines.en: So you've identified the specific communication nodes involved?
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Gentle but focused. The question of someone drawing out a conclusion. Trailing softly—checking if he's understood correctly.
